text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed in eu-west-2. 15m error rate spike (5xx ~ 9.2%, p50 latency +120ms). Paging SRE Oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-5xx

SRE Oncall: Acked. I'm on it. Can folks avoid major deploys into eu-west-2 while we triage?

Maria L: Noted, cancelling queued deploys. Seeing similar in synthetic checks and customer-prod-latency dashboards.

AJ: I'm seeing a pattern where proxy->backend failures correlate with TLS handshake errors from edge pool instance set B. Dumping connection errors now.

Sasha K: Paging infra oncall to check egress NAT and ASG scaling. @Kyle R can you confirm any recent infra changes?

Kyle R: No infra changes in the last 2 hours from our side. I see a sudden jump in open connections on edgepool-euw2-b-3, probably thread exhaustion. Running `sudo netstat -anp | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l` on the host gives ~14k (baseline 2k).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback of rollout/feature-proxy-ttl started by ci-cd (detected failing rate)

SRE Oncall: Good catch re: connection saturation. Immediate mitigation options: 1) shift traffic weight from eu-west-2 to eu-west-1 (soft failover), 2) enable local circuit-breaker to shed long-tail requests, 3) scale edgepool instances. Which should we prioritize?

Maria L: Start with soft failover to eu-west-1 for user-facing routes and keep eu-west-2 as warm fallback. We need to avoid customer-facing errors.

AJ: I'm running the weight shift now. Command: ``rctl traffic steer --from eu-west-2 --to eu-west-1 --weight 0.7 --reason "euw2 gateway saturation"``

SRE Oncall: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Executing manual circuit-breaker on edge-proxy in eu-west-2 to drop retries > 3 and 2s slow-requests. Patch config applied.``
config:
```
proxy.max_retries: 3
proxy.slow_request_threshold_ms: 2000
proxy.shed_policy: 0.15
```

Sasha K: K8s HPA for edgepool-euw2 set to min 3, current desired 9, scaling delay observed due to image pull. Suggest temporarily spin up spare instances in eu-west-1 instead of waiting.

Kyle R: Agreed. Spinning up 6 extra edgepool instances in eu-west-1 now and pinning them to the gateway pool.

Olivia P: Quick customer impact update: top 5 customers in eu-west-2 show partial degradation (inflight errors ~7-10%). Support alerted and standing by to inform affected accounts.

SRE Oncall: After steering, 5xx rate in eu-west-2 dropped to 3.5% but latency p95 increased in eu-west-1 by ~40ms. Acceptable tradeoff for availability. Monitoring closely.

Maria L: Re enabling of request caching on frontend to reduce backend load for common prefixes. Deployed a short TTL cache policy for 10m.

AJ: Added temporary prefix cache config: ``/v1/embeddings/* ttl=600`` — reduced RPS to backends by ~18%.

SRE Oncall: Checking logs for root cause: many `connection reset by peer` from internal proxy to model-worker on port 443. Could be thread exhaustion or kernel limits. Running `ss -s` and `dmesg | tail`.

Kyle R: Kernel log shows `nf_conntrack: table full` spikes around ping time. We increased conntrack in previous ramp for another region but looks like table exhausted here. Increasing conntrack table size now. Command: ``sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144``

ops-bot: ops-bot: conntrack max increased on edgepool-euw2-b-*.

Sasha K: Will patch autoscaler to use warm pools to avoid image-pull delay. But that's medium-term. For now keep failover weight to eu-west-1 at 70%.

Olivia P: Support: two enterprise customers (AcmeCorp, BrightChat) have open tickets complaining of 502s. CS has informed them we're routing traffic and will provide status updates.

SRE Oncall: Running a quick probe sweep to verify backend health post conntrack bump. Health checks are green for most workers now; intermittent drops persist on pool B hosts.

Maria L: Can we add a temporary sticky routing to route sessions created before the incident back to eu-west-2 to reduce churn? That might reduce retries.

AJ: Implemented session stickiness heuristics on the LB layer for known tokens. Command: ``lbctl set-sticky --region eu-west-2 --token-list /secrets/active_tokens`` — applied.

SRE Oncall: Metrics: overall 5xx across platform from eu-west-2 reduced to 1.1% after combined mitigations. Latency regressions in eu-west-1 within SLO for now.

Maria L: Great. Recommending we keep failover active for another 90 minutes while we stabilize and perform deeper post-incident analysis.

Sasha K: Taking notes for postmortem: root cause candidate = conntrack table exhaustion + edgepool thread exhaustion + slow scale due to image pull. Follow-ups: tune conntrack defaults, pre-warm edgepool images, add backpressure earlier in proxy. Assign to infra and runtime teams.

Kyle R: Will follow up on conntrack tuning and pre-warm image job. ETA for action items: conntrack tuning change script today, pre-warm job PR by EOD.

Olivia P: Support will send templated update to affected customers: summary + ETA + workaround (retries suppressed, temporary failover).

SRE Oncall: Handoff: I'm still on shift for 18 more minutes. If things remain stable, I'll transition to next oncall @AJ. Otherwise we'll escalate.

AJ: I'll take the handoff if metrics stay stable for the next 20. Noted follow-ups and will create tracking tickets: INF-3421 (conntrack), RUNTIME-889 (edgepool pre-warm), SRE-550 (runbook updates).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/feature-proxy-ttl automatically rolled back.

incident-bot: Incident: eu-west-2 gateway partial degradation -> mitigated via soft failover to eu-west-1, conntrack bump, cache TTL changes, and temporary circuit-breakers. Severity: Sev2. Postmortem owner: Sasha K.

Maria L: Adding final note: keep tracing and request sampling high for next 24h for correlation.

SRE Oncall: Confirmed. Lowering channel noise: please use #incidents for updates. I'll file a short incident bridge summary in the incident tracker and link here tomorrow. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

AJ: :thumbsup: closing handoff to me. Monitoring until 04:30 UTC.

Olivia P: Support update queued to customers.

Sasha K: Assigned postmortem and will gather logs/graphs.

incident-bot: Closing note scheduled in 1h with final severity review.
